paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance change brought by different sizes of the in-context pool.

model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the relationship between a ratio and a metric termed minADE20 (represented in units of ‘→’). The x-axis is labeled “Ratio”, has a linear scale, ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, and has tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The y-axis is labeled “minADE20 (→)”, has a linear scale, ranges from 15.4 to 17.6, and has tick labels at 15.6, 16.0, 16.4, 16.8, and 17.2. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “TrajICL” and begins at approximately 16.7 when Ratio is 0.0 and declines to approximately 15.7 when Ratio is 1.0. An orange line, marked with circular data points, represents “Head Tuning” and begins at approximately 17.2 when Ratio is 0.0 and declines to approximately 16.2 when Ratio is 1.0. A green line, marked with circular data points, represents “FT” and begins at approximately 17.3 when Ratio is 0.0 and declines to approximately 16.1 when Ratio is 1.0, then increases to approximately 16.2 when Ratio is 1.0. A magenta line, marked with circular data points, represents “LoRA 16” and begins at approximately 17.1 when Ratio is 0.0 and declines to approximately 15.9 when Ratio is 1.0. A purple line, marked with circular data points, represents “LoRA 64” and begins at approximately 17.4 when Ratio is 0.0 and declines to approximately 16.1 when Ratio is 1.0.
model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between ‘Ratio’ and ‘minADE20’, for different training methods. The x-axis is labeled “Ratio” and is a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. The y-axis is labeled “minADE20 (→)” and is a linear scale ranging from 15.5 to 17.5, with tick labels at 16.0, 16.5, 17.0, and 17.5. The TrajICL line is blue, with circular markers, and shows a decline from approximately 17.2 at a Ratio of 0.0 to 16.0 at a Ratio of 1.0, with a data point at 16.6 at a Ratio of 0.2. The Head Tuning line is orange, with circular markers, and shows a relatively steady decline, beginning around 17.3 at a Ratio of 0.0 and reaching approximately 17.1 at a Ratio of 1.0. The FT line is green, with circular markers, and begins at approximately 17.1 at a Ratio of 0.0 before declining to 16.2 at a Ratio of 0.4, then increasing to 16.4 at a Ratio of 1.0. The LoRA 16 line is red, with circular markers, showing a decline from about 17.2 at a Ratio of 0.0 to 16.4 at a Ratio of 1.0. Finally, the LoRA 64 line is purple, with circular markers, and shows a decrease from approximately 17.1 at a Ratio of 0.0 to 16.5 at a Ratio of 1.0.
